# Reines Property Development

Reines Property Development Limited is a property development, construction, and manufacturing company based in Blantyre, Malawi. Founded in March 2023, the company operates across property development, building and civil contracting, and in-house production of concrete products, stone products, and dry-mix construction materials.

## About
Reines is focused on driving Malawi's development through property, construction and manufacturing excellence. Its vision is to become Malawi and Southern Africa's most trusted and innovative property development, construction, and sustainable building manufacturer.

## Content
The website contains information about Reines Property Development Limited, its services, manufactured products, public project portfolio, market insights, client portal app (Reines Project Mate), quotation requests, and official contact details. Authenticated client and project-manager portals are available for live project tracking, milestones, progress galleries, messaging, and payments.
